name: Disneyland Blue Bayou Restaurant Center-Cut Filet Mignon or Sustainable Fish & Mashed Potatoes (Plain Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Blue Bayou Restaurant (New Orleans Square · Disneyland Park)
whyItWorks: Blue Bayou's kitchen readily accommodates dietary requests—ordering the Center-Cut Filet Mignon or Market Sustainable Fish seasoned simply with salt and olive oil alongside mashed potatoes or white rice lets you enjoy the Pirates of the Caribbean ambiance safely.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask your server for the Filet Mignon or Sustainable Fish prepared "plain grilled with olive oil and kosher salt only—no Cajun blackening spice and no citrus/cream sauce," paired with mashed potatoes or steamed white rice and warm dinner rolls.
watchOuts: Skip the spicy Jambalaya, dark-roux Gumbo, and deep-fried Monte Cristo during flares
